<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif">
  <!-- Jerry Rosenberg: a gold wedding ring cracks and falls apart, the scales swing and settle, the name in gold. -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="jr_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#14100c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2c2218"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="jr_gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff0b0"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#d0a040"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7a5410"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#jr_bg)"/>
  <path d="M0 80 C160 60 220 140 400 100 S600 160 640 120 M0 300 C120 260 300 330 460 280 S620 300 640 270" stroke="#3a2e22" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <g transform="translate(320 110)">
    <g opacity="1">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.7;1" dur="2s" fill="freeze"/>
      <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0;0,0;-40,30" keyTimes="0;0.4;1" dur="1.6s" fill="freeze"/>
        <path d="M0 -40 A40 40 0 0 0 0 40" fill="none" stroke="url(#jr_gold)" stroke-width="9"/></g>
      <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0;0,0;40,30" keyTimes="0;0.4;1" dur="1.6s" fill="freeze"/>
        <path d="M0 -40 A40 40 0 0 1 0 40" fill="none" stroke="url(#jr_gold)" stroke-width="9"/></g>
      <path d="M0 -52 L5 -40 L-4 -28 L4 -16" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="0.3s" begin="0.6s"/></path>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0" stroke="url(#jr_gold)" stroke-width="3" fill="none">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.6s" begin="1.6s" fill="freeze"/>
      <path d="M0 -50 V50 M-30 50 H30"/>
      <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-14;9;-5;2;0" dur="2.2s" begin="1.6s" fill="freeze"/>
        <path d="M-80 -40 H80 M-80 -40 L-95 0 H-65 Z M80 -40 L65 0 H95 Z"/></g>
    </g>
  </g>
  <text x="320" y="240" font-size="52" fill="url(#jr_gold)" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="3" opacity="0">JERRY ROSENBERG<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.8s" begin="2.2s" fill="freeze"/><animate attributeName="letter-spacing" values="12;3" dur="0.8s" begin="2.2s" fill="freeze"/></text>
  <text x="320" y="282" font-size="18" fill="#c8a860" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="12" opacity="0">═══ FAMILY LAW ═══<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.6s" begin="3s" fill="freeze"/></text>
  <text x="320" y="320" font-size="16" fill="#a08860" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic" opacity="0">"divorce attorney"<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.6s" begin="3.8s" fill="freeze"/></text>
</svg>
name: jerry_rosenberg_logo
